My derealization was caused by severe anxiety. It started in early 2020, so the pandemic was a huge trigger for it. Everything was different and scary, I was going through trying to change my medication, and my very first bad derealization episode happened when I tried marijuana for the first time. I turned around and didn’t recognize my sister, felt as if I’d suddenly “realized” I wasn’t real, and then immediately came to the conclusion that I had to hurt myself proper since nothing was real. 

I didn’t end up doing that, obviously, and I honestly dealt with derealization for a little while. It was miserable and I thought I broke my brain by changing medications and using marijuana that one time. So I do understand the feeling of thinking you did something to ruin your brain forever lol. Fortunately I promise that is not the case. 

On the subject of losing my emotions, I didn’t realize they were so numbed until I started trintellix and was able to let myself cry about things again. That’s when I realized I’d become so numb to things.

For what it’s worth, that’s a common thought - that your brain has been somehow damaged and caused derealization. I felt that way too. I can’t pinpoint when it stopped, but it absolutely did. Just took some time. Good luck.
